cited.quote: RTO: Recovery Time Objective. The maximum acceptable time to restore a service after a disaster. Not to be confused with return-to-office arrangements, which are covered by the Remote Work Policy

questions.answer: If the primary on-call does not acknowledge the page within 15 minutes, the paging tool automatically pages the secondary. If the secondary also fails to acknowledge within another 15 minutes, the page goes to the team’s engineering manager. For an active SEV1, an engineer can bypass the timers by calling the secondary directly through extension 304, which rings both the secondary’s phone and the manager’s phone at the same time. If the secondary also fails to acknowledge within another 15 minutes, the page goes to the team's engineering manager.")
